bio.text: Terri Pickens is the Democratic candidate for governor of Idaho in 2026; she was the Democratic nominee for lieutenant governor in 2022, losing to Republican Scott Bedke.
She is a Boise attorney and the founding partner of Pickens Law, and she lives in Boise.
She grew up in Pocatello, won a track scholarship to the University of Southern California, and earned a law degree from the University of Idaho College of Law.
She worked about three years as a public defender in Nez Perce County in the late 1990s before founding her own law firm in Boise.
